text:
rachel: Quick bring-up: ran onboarding eval for 'nova-embed-int5' against baseline nova-v2 on code+wiki_holdout (8k queries). Summary below.

eric: tl;dr numbers please

rachel: Baseline recall@10 = 0.835. nova-embed-int5 = 0.802 (delta -0.033). Paired bootstrap p=0.0018. recall@100 delta -0.011.

toby: Oof. Which slices hit hardest?

rachel: Short queries <=3 tokens and symbol-rich queries (code/math) account for ~62% of top-err tail. Top failed example: "std::vector::emplace_back" (sample id 482119).

eric: Any norm/centroid metrics?

rachel: Mean embedding norm -4.6% vs baseline. Mean intra-cluster cosine 0.71 -> 0.66. Silhouette k=120 drops 0.32 -> 0.26. UMAP shows topic smear: code cluster leaks into api cluster.

nora: Did you try per-channel quant? Or bias correction?

rachel: Per-row (symmetric) default run first. Per-channel queued now. Also tried simple post-quant L2 scale: multiply vectors by 1.05 -> recall@10 to 0.813 (partial recovery).

toby: Good. Can you run asymmetric zero-point + per-channel + small output bias correction? Also try renorming: x = x / ||x|| * median_norm_baseline.

rachel: On it. Kicked off sweep: per-channel, asymmetric zp, norm-rescale, and a 6->5-bit hybrid fallback.

eric: Please save top-500 failed sample ids and UMAP diffs. We need human QA.

qa-bot: qa-bot: Artifact bundle created s3://redwood-artifacts/6777778888/umap_and_failures.tar.gz

nora: If per-channel + asym closes >70% of gap and latency delta <3% we can consider canary. Otherwise hold.

rachel: Also adding short-query routing mitigation: queries <=3 tokens -> route to nova-v2 during canary window. Implemented as short-query route flag for deploy.

toby: Add a check to log only sample ids (no raw query content) for privacy.

rachel: Will log ids + tokenized signature only. Repro snippet: ```bash
./eval_holdout.sh --model nova-embed-int5 --holdout code_wiki_8k \
  --k 10,100 --resamples 1000 --perturbs none --save-fail-ids 500
```

eric: One more thought: try tiny isotropic noise during calibrate phase before quantizing to spread mass away from zero-center bins, helped before.

rachel: Queued small-noise calibrate run. Posting updated numbers in ~45m.

nora: Thanks. If canary shows >2.5% recall@10 degradation on production trace we'll auto-revert. Also schedule manual QA review of top-100 samples after sweeps.

rachel: Noted. Will attach sample IDs + UMAP zips when ready. :thumbsup:
